correctness.rationale: For the required event Pi(i)=j and Pi(j)=i, the other n-2 images are uniformly permuted on the remaining labels; pairwise inversion probabilities split into the fixed pair (one), two free positions (one half), and x=i-1,y=j-i-1,z=n-j mixed positions. Their contributions (y+2z)/d,(d+y)/d,(2x+y)/d with d=n-2 yield Delta=1/2+[y^2-(x-z)^2]/d, algebraically the claimed factorization. The event probability is 1/[n(n-1)], and summing local covariance gives Cov(I,C2)=1/12. Riemann-area sign analysis applies away from u=1/2 or v=1/2; n=3 is covered by d=1. Independent direct enumeration through n=7 corroborates exact formulas, not the asymptotic proof.
